# Progress — PUTPBAA (session pick-up-the-phone-booth-and-aisle-kimi-07c4bb84ff, branch b0)

Date: 2026-09-27. Status: COMPLETE — winning ending verified; finish claim ACCEPTED by broker as event e00060 (ending_claim, "awaiting Terra ending verification"). m0039 was rejected once (quote mismatch due to line wrap); corrected verbatim quote accepted in m0040.

## Completion
- WINNING ENDING (verified twice, identical sha c18ce248...): `push booth` ->
  "You may recall, in the original game, this action won the game. I guess that's why you tried it. Well, full points for good memory. / *** You have won ***"
  - e00018 (probe), e00057 (dedicated finale run).
- The manifest's preferred title-action branch was TESTED and is FATAL in this sequel:
  `pick up phone booth` (e00055) -> "YOU DIE, OK? Sheesh. / *** You have died ***", byte-identical to all take/pick-up variants (e00006, e00011, e00042).
- Therefore completion was claimed on the game's authored, nonfatal, explicit-win ending (`push booth`), per the manifest allowance for a coherent nonfatal authored narrative ending ("preferably" title branch; title branch excluded as ordinary death).

## Game structure
- One room; every command yields an authored ending + RESTART/RESTORE/QUIT menu; `restart` recovers. Parser rejections (unknown verb, empty line, dangling pronoun) do not end the game. Commands at the end-menu get "Please give one of the answers above."
- No SAVE/RESTORE/checkpoint used (forbidden by collection notes). No lamps/timers.
- Help broker only returned walkthrough header lines (m0008/m0009); guidance was not usable; conclusions rest on observed game output.

## Annotations filed (all synthetic probes, unreviewed labels)
- e00029 accepted paraphrase: `x booth` == `examine phone booth` (failure_type none).
- e00052 omitted object `take`: parser auto-guessed booth, lethal (ambiguity).
- e00053 dangling pronoun `take it`: "I'm not sure what 'it' refers to." (ambiguity; no safe repair exists).
- e00054 commands typed at end-menu rejected (world_state; e00012/e00046 -> recovery e00013).
- e00058 typo `pik up booth` -> corrected `pick up phone booth`; parser accepted but branch authored as death (vocabulary).
- e00059 word-order `pick the phone booth up` == `pick up phone booth`, both lethal (syntax; hypothesis of parse difference refuted at outcome level).

## Case inventory (24 distinct commands probed)
look, x booth, examine phone booth, take, take phone, take it, pick up, pick the phone booth up, pick up phone booth, open booth, enter booth, push booth, kiss booth, listen, go north, jump, wait, shout, inventory, talk to booth, xyzzy, think, dial 911, empty line. Plus 10 in-game restarts (recovery) and 2 help requests.

## Requests
- m0001–m0038 issued and serviced. m0039 = finish.
